title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent call recaps for call queue calls in the Queues app
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing prerequisites, control paths and commands are supported. It appropriately leaves queue-recap-specific defaults and permissions open; a minor correction should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft documentation about mobile support for the surrounding Queues app.

Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()
